title: Japanese-Style Roasted Canadian Salmon
description: A simple yet flavorful dish featuring roasted Canadian salmon, served with a fluffy side of egg and rice.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Place the salmon on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the roasted soy sauce over the salmon.
Sprinkle the white sesame seeds over the salmon.
Roast in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Cook the fluffy Japanese rice according to package instructions.
Fry the egg in a pan until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to desired doneness.
Mince the roast garlic and sprinkle over the egg.
Serve the roasted salmon with a side of fluffy Japanese rice and the fried egg.
